B: ∀ᵐ e (volume), not focal, for any slice structure hNN on N with complement ℝ^{K+1}, dim M ≥ 1. Neither direction transfers anything. A is re-proved outright in B_to_A from the same Sard theorem and the project's focalSet_eq_image_critPoints (V4_2, outside the item). Moving between the two structures on N would need uniqueness of the smooth structure of an embedded submanifold. The substantive content (Sard) is the same on both sides.
